title: N8n security advisory (AV26-1200)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1200 Date: November 24, 2026 As of November 23, 2026, n8n is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product: n8n Prior to 3.4.0 Prior to 2.50.0 Prior to 2.49.5 Prior to 2.48.8 Prior to 1.123.101 Prior to 2.49.4 Prior to 2.48.7 Prior to 1.123.100 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. n8n-io / n8n Releases Overview · n8n-io/n8n · GitHub Article Link: n8n security advisory (AV26-1200) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
exclude_reason: Cyber Centre serial advisory lists n8n fixed versions without CVEs, impact, or attack detail; no substance beyond a patch-version notice.
